This '''mercenary''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was hired by [[Darth Nyriss]] to follow a lead pertaining to the [[Assassination attempts on Darth Nyriss|attacks on her life]] and to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]]. He and his [[Unidentified female mercenary (Dromund Kaas)|partner]] was slaughtered outside [[Darth Nyriss's stronghold]] when they [[Skirmish outside of Darth Nyriss's stronghold|attempted]] to assassinate Lord Scourge.

==Biography==
In [[3954 BBY]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] was hired by [[Darth Nyriss]] to follow a lead pertaining to the [[Assassination attempts on Darth Nyriss|attacks on her life]] and to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]]. He and his [[Unidentified female mercenary (Dromund Kaas)|partner]] arrived at [[Darth Nyriss's stronghold]] in a [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] firing the auto-targeting [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] at the Sith Lord, who took shelter behind the [[Statue of the Sith Emperor|statue]] of the [[Tenebrae|Emperor]]. After seeing that they were turning around to make another pass, Scourge [[Telekinesis/Legends#Saber throw|threw]] his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] at the speeder clipping the back end. They abandoned the speeder, after beheading the statue of the Emperor and crash landing. He attempted to free his [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] of the wreckage, while his partner drew her [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] and attempted to defend her partner. Scourge [[Force jump/Legends|leapt]] over the speeder and slew the mercenary before he could bring his weapon to bear.<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The male mercenary first appeared in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', which was released on [[November 15]], [[2011]].
